description: This Dart file defines a FavoritesProvider class for managing a list of favorite recipe IDs within a Flutter application. It uses ChangeNotifier to communicate changes to the UI and provides methods to add, remove, toggle, and clear favorites. The class maintains an in-memory set of IDs and exposes a read-only view of this set.

classes.name: FavoritesProvider
classes.description: A change notifier that manages the user's favorite recipe IDs in memory, allowing addition, removal, toggling, and clearing of favorites.

methods.name: favoriteIds
methods.description: Provides an unmodifiable view of the current set of favorite recipe IDs.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of favorited recipes.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a given recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a recipe ID to the favorites set.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a recipe ID from the favorites set.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe ID.
